feature_name: 005 A Banking Transfer System With Audit Logging

kpis.name: Account risk profile score
kpis.formal_constraint: Structural density of `sig Account` relations: count of distinct destinations, average transfer frequency, ratio of flagged transfers to total transfers (`sig FraudSignal` cardinality / `sig Transfer` cardinality per account)
kpis.measurement_strategy: Nightly batch job computes per-account risk score; stored in account profile; consumed by fraud evaluation and compliance reporting
kpis.source_location: spec.md: Formal Requirements & Advanced KPI Mapping

kpis.name: Audit write success rate = 100% (fail-closed)
kpis.formal_constraint: `pred writeAuditEntry` — precondition: audit store reachable; postcondition: AuditEntry persisted and hash chain extended; transfer gated on audit success
kpis.measurement_strategy: Circuit breaker metrics on audit store connectivity; transfer failure attribution tags in APM traces
kpis.source_location: spec.md: Formal Requirements & Advanced KPI Mapping

kpis.name: Insufficient-fund rejection propensity
kpis.formal_constraint: `sig Account.availableBalance` relative to `sig Transfer.amount` in `pred executeTransfer` precondition check; propensity = `1 - (availableBalance / intendedAmount)` clamped [0,1]
kpis.measurement_strategy: Pre-transfer balance-to-amount ratio logged; correlated with rejection outcomes to calibrate client-side warnings
kpis.source_location: spec.md: Formal Requirements & Advanced KPI Mapping

kpis.name: Reversal correctness rate = 100%
kpis.formal_constraint: `pred reverseTransfer` — precondition: original Transfer.status = COMPLETED, within ReversalWindow; postcondition: compensating Transfer created, MoneyConservation fact preserved
kpis.measurement_strategy: Post-reversal automated balance assertion; exception counter on any conservation violation
kpis.source_location: spec.md: Formal Requirements & Advanced KPI Mapping

kpis.name: Step-up authentication completion rate ≥ 75%
kpis.formal_constraint: `pred stepUpAuth` — triggered when `pred evaluateFraudRisk` returns score above threshold; success = user completes challenge within timeout
kpis.measurement_strategy: Funnel metrics: step-up issued → step-up completed → transfer re-attempted; tracked per user cohort
kpis.source_location: spec.md: Formal Requirements & Advanced KPI Mapping

kpis.name: Transfer completion rate ≥ 99.5% for valid requests
kpis.description: Transfer completion rate ≥ 99.5% for valid requests
kpis.formal_constraint: `pred executeTransfer` — preconditions: `Account.availableBalance ≥ Transfer.amount`, `Account.status = ACTIVE`, `User.authenticated = true`; postcondition: both Accounts updated atomically
kpis.measurement_strategy: API response status code distribution logged to time-series DB; dashboard alert on completion rate drop below threshold
kpis.source_location: spec.md: Formal Requirements & Advanced KPI Mapping

kpis.name: Transfer fraud propensity score (precision ≥ 80%, recall ≥ 90%)
kpis.formal_constraint: `sig FraudSignal` computed from relational density of `sig Transfer` linked to `sig Account`: velocity (count of transfers in sliding window), amount deviation (z-score vs. account historical mean), destination novelty (new `sig Account` in destination relation)
kpis.measurement_strategy: Fraud signal outcomes labeled in case management system; precision/recall computed monthly; model recalibrated quarterly
kpis.source_location: spec.md: Formal Requirements & Advanced KPI Mapping
